scope: Fresh named/custom-data stone observations through the same public Client on original vanilla 1.16.1 and 1.21.11, survival and creative. Not arbitrary component parsing, normalized semantic data or component-bearing gameplay support.
authority_limits: Original JVMs sequential, heap 1 GiB, one active CPU. Disposable tmpfs directories exported after clean exit then removed.
Actual source and consumer binary digests were captured before execution at b0a0012 plus staged frame coalescing/trace changes; later evidence/tests/docs are not retrospectively part of those inputs.
RCON fields independently verify exact count, marker and name, plus unchanged pose. Readonly traces never manufacture Client receipt ordinals.

Final traces have no errors or undelivered terminal frames. Complete clientbound BrokenPipe after explicitly requested disconnect can be retained as undelivered; all partial frames and outgoing errors still fail.
Earlier trace-failing native runs stay failed. Coalescing header/body removes an artificial short-write await boundary, not general TCP atomicity; genuine cancellation/write uncertainty remains.

packet_trace.authority_limits: Read-only byte-for-byte forwarding of original protocol frames; decompression only for diagnostics, no game method/packet replacement. Trace errors remain failures; terminal context does not fabricate a complete frame.
